title: The House from Nowhere

As tensions rise and Philon's desperation leads him to unethical choices, the story culminates in a tragic turn of events that forces him to confront the cost of his ambitions and the emptiness of his lifestyle, leading to John’s departure in search of a more authentic connection to life.
